page.notes: Printed text is rendered with normalised u/v and i/j. Several words are set with the long-s form, transcribed as plain s. The text ends mid-sentence at the foot with "ne", which is probably the start of the catchword-like word "neque" but is printed as a line-end fragment; it is kept as printed. The description "ex venis" and "descripsisset" were read with some uncertainty: the scan shows "descripsisse" ending on the line, so "descripsisse[?]" may be intended.
